name: C0 0x83 raw memory read
about: Extends the C0 0x83 read so setting bit 31 of the address makes it a raw memory memcpy instead of a SPI-flash read. `hl read 0x80000000 <len> out.bin` dumps mask ROM (ROM calls live around 0x8000-0x12000); any mapped address works the same way. Stock behavior is unchanged for addresses with bit 31 clear. The stub is a leaf using only scratch regs r0-r3. CAUTION: reading an unmapped or peripheral address can fault the bud (worst case a reboot); stick to 0x0-0x20000 for ROM first.

ops.what: mem-read stub in dead space (XIP 0xC30032): if bit31 of the read addr is set, memcpy(addr&0x7fffffff, len) into the reply buffer, else tail-call the stock flash read FUN_0080576c
0x83 read handler (FUN_00c69b3c, XIP 0xc69d26): reroute bl FUN_0080576c -> bl stub@0xC30032
